title: Improved Lakeflow Performance Observability is now generally available
body: Lakeflow Jobs now show query performance metrics and insights at the job level for supported tasks. You can view job-level data volume metrics and use the **Optimize** button to open Genie Code to help improve queries with performance insights. See [View query performance metrics for serverless jobs](/aws/en/jobs/diagnose-job-performance#query-performance-metrics).

ref_links.text: View query performance metrics for serverless jobs
